info.description: Bounded simulator subset of the official AWS App Mesh API (2019-01-25). Every other official operation returns HTTP 501 UnknownOperationException. Meshes, virtual nodes, virtual routers, virtual services and virtual gateways are configuration metadata: no Envoy proxy configuration is served, no traffic is routed, and service discovery, backend, listener and TLS settings are stored without resolving DNS names, AWS Cloud Map services, certificates or files. Routes and gateway routes are not implemented because they are nested two levels below a mesh; CreateRoute, CreateGatewayRoute and their other operations return UnknownOperationException with HTTP 501. Virtual services therefore refuse a provider, which would name a virtual node or router. Each resource keeps metadata version 1 and its creation time as lastUpdatedAt after updates. Meshes are owned by the simulator account: meshOwner must be that account, so shared meshes are not available. Deleting a mesh that still has virtual resources is refused. Update client tokens are accepted but not recorded. ListTagsForResource returns every tag and refuses limit and nextToken.
info.title: AWS App Mesh (simulator catalog)
